### Reproducibility Checklist

- [ ] Experiment config file created in `configs/experiment/`
- [ ] All hyperparameters documented
- [ ] Random seed fixed for reproducibility
- [ ] Dependencies and environment documented
- [ ] Data preprocessing steps documented
- [ ] Experiment tagged appropriately in W&B
- [ ] Results can be reproduced with provided config
